Class DoubleArrayList

java.lang.Object
math.DoubleArrayList
public class DoubleArrayList extends Object
this class creates a dynamic list of double. it is useful to use when you want to access the elements randomly, but you have often to cancel the first part of list or to add elements in the end but in general the size is approximately constant.
Author:
Federico Granata
